preconditions.description: The input consists of exactly three lines.
The integers n and m on the first line equal the lengths of strings s and t respectively.
The string s contains at most one wildcard character '*'.

preconditions.expression: all(c.islower() for c in t) and all(c.islower() or c == '*' for c in s)
preconditions.description: String t consists only of lowercase Latin letters, and s consists of lowercase Latin letters and at most one '*'.
The lengths n and m are within the range [1, 2*10^5].

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if (has_star and (s_prefix == t[:len(s_prefix)] and s_suffix == t[-len(s_suffix):] and len(s_prefix) + len(s_suffix) <= m)) or (not has_star and s == t) else 'NO'
postconditions.description: Output 'YES' if s matches t (either s equals t exactly when no wildcard exists, or the prefix before '*' and suffix after '*' in s match the corresponding parts of t with non-overlapping indices), otherwise output 'NO'.
